'''Steve Brentson''' won the [[2000 Kashyyyk Regionals]].<ref name="dc00fin" /> He finished 2nd at the [[1998 Corellia Regional (Indianapolis)]].<ref name="list-53912" /> He played the [[1998 Decipher World Championship]] and the [[2026 Boston Winter Classic]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-01-boston-winter-classic-boston-massachusetts-jan-10-to-11-2026/ 2026 Boston Winter Classic], starwarsccg.org</ref>
